hooks.name: Verify after spec task
hooks.description: After each spec task: type-check, lint and run the whole test suite, so a task can never silently break earlier work (see steering/working-with-existing-code.md)

action.command: npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc --noEmit -p tests && npx eslint src tests mcp-wayback --max-warnings 0 && npx vitest run
